image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor). The fish displays the characteristic black head and anterior body, transitioning to a golden-yellow posterior body and tail. The scales are clearly visible with a reticulated pattern. The dorsal and anal fins are extended, showing yellow margins and blue accents near the body. The background consists of blurred blue water and indistinct reef structures.
